reason: The proof applies the closed-set characterization of continuity and correctly identifies the zero set with the preimage of \(\{0\}\).
text:
Since \(f:X\to\mathbb R\) is continuous and \(\{0\}\) is closed in \(\mathbb R\), the inverse image \(f^{-1}(\{0\})\) is closed in \(X\). Moreover,
\[
f^{-1}(\{0\})=\{p\in X:f(p)=0\}=Z(f).
\]
Therefore \(Z(f)\) is closed in \(X\).
